attributes.probed_form: NO SOURCE EDIT. The probed forms are command lines, replayed from build.ninja per TU and fidelity-gated to byte-identity against the shipped .postprocess/body object before use. Variant flags appended to the TU's own cflags: -opt {nolifetimes,lifetimes,nopropagation,noschedule,schedule,nopeephole,peephole,nocse,nodeadcode,nodeadstore,noloopinvariants,nostrength,nodead,nofunctions,space,speed,level=1,level=2,level=3}; -schedule {on,off}; -inline {auto,level=1|2|3, noauto, all, deferred, on, off}; -func_align {4,8,16,32}; and compiler-directory swaps to GC/{1.0,1.1,1.1p1,1.2.5,1.2.5n,1.3,1.3.2,1.3.2r,2.0,2.0p1,2.5,2.6,2.7,3.0a3,3.0a3.2,3.0a3.3,3.0a3.4,3.0a3p1,3.0a5,3.0a5.2} and Wii/{1.0,1.1,1.3}.
attributes.residual: Unchanged. MBPsysSetDebugNode's raw residual is 8 differing words forming the single transposition {r6->r7, r7->r6}; it measured exactly 8 under all 56 variants. Representatives across the other classes behaved identically: sysservice::sysClearFlags 4 (r4->r0) invariant under 54 compiling variants; ml_mem::AllocFile 2 (permutation) invariant; audio.c::{AudioBankQueueName,AudioUnloadPart,AudioBankLoadName} 2 each (live-zero) invariant; newcam::fn_8006E654 2 (live-zero) invariant; gcontrolpads::G3DReadControlPadStates invariant. The ONE exception found is a positive control, not a dissolution: mb_particle::getSinCos (pure FPR recolor) is reproduced byte-exactly by GC/3.0a3 and GC/3.0a5.2, which simultaneously break 33 of that TU's 39 strict functions.
attributes.scope: INVESTIGATION lane under work_claim.compiler-variant.20260901.v1. Zero source edits, zero webfrank.json edits, no compiler swap shipped. Owned paths: CV_scratch/ (untracked) and the promoted tools/gdl/composed_census/cv_*.py.
attributes.verification: Fidelity gate: 12/12 representative TUs replayed byte-identical to their shipped .postprocess/body object. Sweep: 616 variant compiles over 11 TUs, 591 successful. 25 compile failures were DIAGNOSED, not assumed: 18 on ml_mem.c and 3 on movieplayer.cpp are GC/1.3+ and Wii promoting an implicit `const char *` -> `char *` conversion from warning to error under -maxerrors 1 — a language-strictness change, NOT contention and NOT a codegen fact, so the compiler axis on those two TUs is incomplete for those versions and is recorded as such. git status clean apart from the untracked lane scratch.
